title: Purple Dragon Egg
description: A large glowing purple egg with crackling energy patterns floats above a reflective surface. Inside its translucent shell, a black dragon-like creature with purple eyes and long tail is curled in a dynamic pose. The background shows a surreal alien landscape with dripping organic structures, glowing pathways, and splashes of purple liquid under a dark twilight sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene featuring a large translucent purple egg floating above a reflective liquid surface with glowing concentric circles. Inside the egg is a black dragon-like creature with purple eyes curled in an energetic pose. The background is a dark alien landscape with dripping organic formations, glowing teal pathways, purple liquid splashes, and distant glowing structures under a purple and green twilight sky.
